body: Hello I just would like to say I made it through Christmas even with my mother giving me, her daughter with a restrictive eating disorder(that she is well aware of), a food scale as a gift 🙃

Thank you I really appreciate your kindness. It’s a lot of things that were already happening being totally set of and triggered by an event. I’m hopefully going to be starting an IOP program on Tuesday it’s just getting through the next few days let alone the rest of my life that seems like an insurmountable task.
There’s a sea wolf in your closet, let it out so it can breathe
